open.SUPERSEDED_BY: Steps 15-28 (2026-08-31). The phase is no longer merely unfound: Step 26 EXCLUDES it at 3e11 sigma, having shown symbolically in q that the discriminant curves are genus 0 (short) and genus 8 (long) — NEVER genus 1, so there is no elliptic source and no tower of them. Step 17 adds that the cosine is UNFALSIFIABLE (phase yes, cosine no) and that the only surviving justification would be a KZ/Kohno-Drinfeld holonomy, which nothing supplies. Step 24 closes both eigenphase readings: the Hecke tower repeats the H_3 spectrum and cannot add to it.

open.note: PR #6282: the place IS named (QBetaSingleHabiroGenerator, open with no instance) and the parity IS derived (bar-INVARIANT, not bar-odd). What is missing is a SELECTOR. That PR corrected two of its own three proposed gates — parity is a class FILTER admitting the entire symmetric q-integer family at once, and the Hankel condition c_2*c_4 = c_3^2 is VACUOUS for rank-1 candidates. The survivors TEST a candidate once you have one; they do not PRODUCE one. The gap is a source, not a test.
